definition: to clean the carpet with a vacuum cleaner
exampleSentence: I vacuum the carpet every Saturday.
exampleTranslation: Thứ Bảy nào tôi cũng hút bụi thảm.

definition: to clean the floor with a vacuum cleaner
exampleSentence: He vacuums the floor twice a week.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy hút bụi sàn nhà hai lần một tuần.

definition: to wipe dust off tables and shelves
exampleSentence: I dust the furniture on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lau bụi đồ đạc vào các Chủ nhật.

definition: to clean a flat area with a cloth
exampleSentence: Wipe the surface with a damp cloth.
exampleTranslation: Lau bề mặt bằng khăn ẩm.

definition: to clean the kitchen work surface
exampleSentence: Please wipe the counter after you cook.
exampleTranslation: Nấu xong nhớ lau mặt bàn bếp nhé.

definition: to clean the floor by rubbing it hard with a brush
exampleSentence: She scrubbed the floor on her hands and knees.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy quỳ xuống chà sàn nhà.

definition: to clean the sink by rubbing it hard
exampleSentence: Scrub the sink with a brush.
exampleTranslation: Cọ bồn rửa bằng bàn chải.

definition: to make the bathroom clean
exampleSentence: We clean the bathroom every weekend.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần nào chúng tôi cũng dọn nhà tắm.

definition: to wash and clean the toilet
exampleSentence: It is my turn to clean the toilet.
exampleTranslation: Đến lượt tôi cọ bồn cầu.

definition: to wash the glass of the windows
exampleSentence: I clean the windows once a month.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lau cửa sổ mỗi tháng một lần.

definition: to rub furniture to make it shine
exampleSentence: She polished the furniture before the guests came.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đánh bóng đồ gỗ trước khi khách đến.

definition: to take the rubbish out of the bin
exampleSentence: Can you empty the bin, please?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đổ thùng rác giúp mình nhé?

definition: to carry the rubbish outside the house
exampleSentence: I take out the rubbish every night.
exampleTranslation: Đêm nào tôi cũng đem rác ra ngoài.

definition: to put rubbish in the bin
exampleSentence: Please throw away your rubbish.
exampleTranslation: Xin hãy vứt rác đúng nơi quy định.

definition: to separate the rubbish into groups for recycling
exampleSentence: We sort the rubbish into paper and plastic.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi phân loại rác thành giấy và nhựa.

definition: to put used bottles where they can be made into new things
exampleSentence: We recycle bottles and cans.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi tái chế chai lọ và lon.

definition: to put a new bag in the bin
exampleSentence: Remember to change the bin bag.
exampleTranslation: Nhớ thay túi rác nhé.

definition: to wash the plates and cups after a meal; British English
exampleSentence: I do the washing-up after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rửa bát đĩa sau bữa tối.

definition: to wash and wipe everything in the kitchen
exampleSentence: We clean the kitchen after we eat.
exampleTranslation: Ăn xong chúng tôi dọn dẹp nhà bếp.

definition: to twist the mop to squeeze the water out
exampleSentence: Wring out the mop before you wash the floor.
exampleTranslation: Vắt nước cây lau nhà trước khi lau sàn.

definition: to open the windows to let fresh air in
translation: mở cửa cho thông thoáng phòng
exampleSentence: I air the room every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng mở cửa cho phòng thông thoáng.

definition: to make a place neat by putting things where they belong
exampleSentence: Please tidy up your room.
exampleTranslation: Con hãy dọn phòng của mình cho gọn gàng.

definition: to shake a rug to get the dust out
exampleSentence: He shakes out the rug outside.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy giũ tấm thảm ngoài sân.

definition: to take dirty marks out of cloth or a surface
exampleSentence: This soap removes stains well.
exampleTranslation: Loại xà phòng này tẩy vết bẩn rất tốt.
